headline: A law that names a post office building in Knox, Pennsylvania, after Specialist Ross A. McGinnis, a soldier.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 523 East Railroad Street in Knox, Pennsylvania, as the "Specialist Ross A. McGinnis Memorial Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, hours, fees, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was signed into law on June 13, 2016.
